sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership and Energy dominance define the market tape, while cyclical and rate-sensitive sectors continue to lag.

Energy maintains undisputed leadership across all timeframes with a 0.967 momentum score, joined by Consumer Defensive (0.817) and Healthcare (0.767) in an all-green breadth profile covering just 3 of 11 sectors. Consumer Defensive posted the strongest short-term rotation, jumping 3 spots over the last five sessions to claim the third overall rank.

Meanwhile, cyclicals are fading. Industrials dropped 2 spots to rank 6 with a weak 0.300 momentum score, and Basic Materials slipped 1 spot to rank 4 (0.450 momentum). At the bottom of the table, Utilities (0.200) and Real Estate (0.217) anchor the laggards, highlighting a sharp performance split across the board.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 3 of 11 groups (Energy, Consumer Defensive, and Healthcare) remain positive across the week, month, quarter, half-year, and YTD timeframes.
- **Energy leadership:** Energy is the sole sustained leader holding a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows, leading the market with a 0.967 momentum score and rank 1 YTD.
- **Defensive resilience:** Consumer Defensive (0.817 momentum, rank 3) and Healthcare (0.767 momentum, rank 5) solidify the top tier of absolute strength.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Consumer Defensive surges:** Advanced +3 spots over the past 5 sessions to rank 3, marking the only positive relative rank improvement in the period.
- **Cyclical deterioration:** Industrials fell 2 spots to rank 6 (momentum 0.300), while Basic Materials fell 1 spot to rank 4 (momentum 0.450).
- **Persistent momentum laggards:** Utilities (0.200, rank 10), Real Estate (0.217, rank 8), and Communication Services (0.367, rank 9) remain pinned near the bottom of the momentum distribution.

## Divergences
- **Technology rank vs. momentum gap:** Technology holds the #2 YTD rank but exhibits a middling momentum score of 0.600, trailing Healthcare (0.767) and Consumer Defensive (0.817).
- **Cyclical divergence:** Consumer Cyclical is pinned at rank 11 with a 0.400 momentum score, decoupled from the higher ranks of earlier cyclical leaders like Basic Materials (rank 4).
- **Fragile all-green signals:** No valid sectors triggered the fragile all-green divergence warning, leaving the three leading groups structurally intact across tested horizons.

rotation_phase.label: Defensive
rotation_phase.reasoning: Consumer Defensive and Healthcare are leading broad market breadth alongside Energy while cyclical sectors like Materials lag, characteristic of a defensive rotation posture.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Energy complexes remain the dominant market leaders with top-tier momentum, while cyclical industrials and select tech infrastructure show abrupt short-term deterioration.

Energy continues to anchor broader market leadership, with Oil & Gas Integrated (0.931 momentum), E&P (0.916), and Refining & Marketing (0.913) holding all-green profiles and sustained top-36 positioning across 1-, 3-, and 6-month timeframes. Concurrently, defensive and consumer segments like Medical Distribution (momentum 0.885, rank +18) and Lodging (momentum 0.85, rank +14) are accelerating rapidly up the ranks.

Conversely, rotation away from rate-sensitive and industrial spaces is accelerating. Heavy decliners such as Coking Coal (-25 spots to rank 113) and Engineering & Construction (-24 spots to rank 51) are unraveling, while foundational laggards like REIT - Mortgage (0.058 momentum) and Solar (0.061 momentum) remain rooted at the bottom of the market.

## Strength
- **Broad Market Breadth:** 24 of 144 industry groups maintain an all-green profile across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and year-to-date metrics.
- **Energy Hegemony:** Oil & Gas Integrated (0.931 momentum, YTD rank 5), E&P (0.916 momentum, YTD rank 8), and Refining & Marketing (0.913 momentum, YTD rank 1) hold sustained strong status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
- **Healthcare & Defensive Anchors:** Medical Distribution (momentum 0.885, YTD rank 41) and Insurance - Reinsurance (momentum 0.86) remain sustained outperformers alongside Health Information Services (momentum 0.82).

## Movers & Momentum
- **Fastest Climbers:** Business Equipment & Supplies (+19 spots to rank 32, 0.80 momentum), Medical Distribution (+18 spots to rank 41, 0.88 momentum), and Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries (+17 spots to rank 60, 0.76 momentum) posted the largest five-day gains.
- **Severe Drops:** Coking Coal dropped 25 spots to rank 113 (0.33 momentum), Engineering & Construction shed 24 spots to rank 51 (0.28 momentum), and Airlines dropped 16 spots to rank 117 (0.23 momentum).
- **Absolute Momentum Laggards:** REIT - Mortgage (0.058 momentum, YTD rank 138), Solar (0.061 momentum, YTD rank 140), and Mortgage Finance (0.065 momentum, YTD rank 142) anchor the absolute bottom of relative performance.

## Divergences
- **Fading Profiles:** Software - Infrastructure displays high overall momentum (0.65) but dropped 14 spots over the past 5 sessions; similarly, Copper (0.69 momentum) slipped 3 spots and Shell Companies (0.71 momentum) lost 4 spots.
- **Emerging Reversals:** Rank improvements are emerging from low-momentum cohorts, led by Restaurants (+8 spots in 5 sessions, 0.45 momentum), Lumber & Wood Production (+8 spots, 0.48 momentum), and Packaged Foods (+7 spots, 0.36 momentum).
